source.check: names and divisions read on the page image of the Lurgan Mail nominations report of 3 May 1930

note: Nomination-day report for the seven divisions of Moira rural district, one member each. All were returned unopposed; in Clare no nomination was made and Mr. S. J. Watson was deemed elected. Filed on 1930-05-30, the Co. Down county and rural district polling day that year (previously filed under 1930-06-05; moved 6 Nov 2026). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
